facts.text: Serve dessert when the girls take Gru to the theme park.
facts.why: It is the other way round. Gru takes the girls to the amusement park, planning to get rid of them, and ends up bonding with them. Agnes asks to go and Gru first says no.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Gru takes the girls to the theme park.

facts.text: Gru reads Sleepy Kittens, then bed.
facts.why: In the transcript Gru gives in and reads Sleepy Kittens to the girls with the puppets. The destroyed book and One Big Unicorn come later in the film.
facts.fix: Gru reads One Big Unicorn, then bed.

facts.text: Gru, can we have pancakes with lots of syrup? I will be really good and I will eat all of mine.
facts.why: Agnes never says this. The pancake line on the Wikiquote page is Edith's, about the pancake Gru bakes for her.
facts.fix: Yes! Mine's shaped like a dead guy!

fix_note.text: Yes! Mine's shaped like a dead guy!
